description: This file defines the IAsyncBatchProducer<T> interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace, which extends IAsyncObserver<T> to support batch production of items in streaming scenarios.

classes.name: IAsyncBatchProducer<T>
classes.description: An interface for producing batches of items asynchronously, extending IAsyncObserver<T> to include batch processing capabilities.

methods.name: OnNextBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously passes a batch of items to the consumer, returning a Task that completes when the batch has been accepted.
